task_ms: Ramal suhu stim keluar daripada 530-545 C
split: Time-based: first 3 days train, next day sets the alert threshold, last ~2 days test (nothing tuned on test)
note: Real data, 5 s readings averaged to 1 min; steam temperature itself is NOT an input. An alert means an excursion starts 10-15 min later; only predicts new excursions (steam in band at alert time). Random alerting would be right 11% of the time. Test AUC 0.54 (0.5 = no skill): with 5 days of one boiler the model finds no usable early warning, and adding the steam temperature history did not help. Data downloaded by script, not redistributed.
